LESSON: SAFETY IN HANDLING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Care for the 3. 3 Managing waste By the end of the sub-strand,  In groups, lear
Topic 3.3.2: Safety in handling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Safety in handling. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify dangers when handling waste in school
2. practice safety measures when handling wastes in school
3. communicate safety measures when handling waste in school
4. appreciate the need of safety in handling waste in school to limit risks to self, others and the environment.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify dangers when handling waste in school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify dangers when handling waste in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. practice safety measures when handling wastes in school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practice safety measures when handling wastes in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. communicate safety measures when handling waste in school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to communicate safety measures when handling waste in school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the need of safety in handling waste in school to limit risks to self, others and the environment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the need of safety in handling waste in school to limit risks to self, others and the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Safety in handling.
2. Explain Safety in handling to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Safety in handling.
4. Show that you can: identify dangers when handling waste in school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Safety in handling. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Safety in handling important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify dangers when handling waste in school
2. practice safety measures when handling wastes in school
3. communicate safety measures when handling waste in school
4. appreciate the need of safety in handling waste in school to limit risks to self, others and the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
